title: Enrichment and Extraction of Phytoplasma DNA from Field Samples for Whole-Genome Sequencing
author: Zala Kogej Zwitter
materials: Precipitate DNA for 20 min at room temperature.
Pipet out the ethanol and dry the pellet.
Combine parallel extractions in one tube.
Use the REPLIg-midi Kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) with an input of 10 ng of enriched DNA and follow Protocol for Amplification of Purified Genomic DNA using the REPLI-g Midi Kit.

steps.title: Prepare Phytoplasma Grinding Buffer
steps.instruction: Make PGB at pH 7.6 containing 0.096 M K2HPO4, 0.03 M KH2PO4, 10 % saharose, 0.15 % BSA, 2 % PVP10 and add 0.03 M ascorbic acid immediately before use; the buffer without ascorbic acid can be stored up to one month at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Make CTAB buffer at pH 8 containing 4 % CTAB, 1 % PVP40, 0.2 M Tris‑HCl, 1.4 M NaCl and 0.02 M EDTA; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect and Cut Leaf Veins
steps.instruction: Cut leaf veins from fresh leaves taken from different parts of the plant.

steps.title: Chop Veins into Small Pieces
steps.instruction: Chop the leaf veins into small pieces with a sterile scalpel.

steps.title: Freeze‑Grind Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the chopped veins with liquid nitrogen in a mortar and pestle until a fine powder is obtained.

steps.title: Transfer Powder to Tubes
steps.instruction: Using a pre‑cooled spatula, transfer exactly 1 g of the frozen powdered tissue into a pre‑cooled 15 mL tube; keep the material frozen at all times. Optionally store the homogenized material at –80 °C until further analysis.

steps.title: Add Grinding Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of the prepared PGB to the 1 g frozen homogenized sample, keep the tube on ice, vortex briefly and give a short spin (ensure the centrifuge does not become warm).

steps.title: Balance Tubes for Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Pour the extract into pre‑cooled 15 mL tubes and add additional PGB as needed to balance the tubes with other samples for centrifugation.

steps.title: Low‑Speed Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2500 g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: High‑Speed Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to fresh pre‑cooled 15 mL tubes, balance carefully using a scale and PGB, then centrifuge at 18 000 g for 25 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Discard Supernatant, Keep Pellet
steps.instruction: Carefully pour out the supernatant, drain the tube on a paper towel and keep the pellet.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents for Next Steps
steps.instruction: Store aliquots of isopropanol and 70 % ethanol at –20 °C and warm the CTAB buffer to 65 °C.

steps.title: Add CTAB to Pellet
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 4 % CTAB buffer (pre‑warmed to 65 °C) to the pellet and resuspend by vortexing.

steps.title: Centrifuge After CTAB
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5000 g for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Chloroform‑Isoamyl Extraction
steps.instruction: Divide the sample into two 1 mL aliquots in 2 mL tubes; to each add an equal volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), vortex, then centrifuge at 6000 g for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Isopropanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phases to fresh 1.5 mL tubes and add an equal volume of ice‑cold isopropanol; mix by inverting.

steps.title: Ethanol Wash of Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the resulting pellet with 300 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 50 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Microbiome DNA Enrichment
steps.instruction: Follow the manufacturer’s protocol for the NEBNext™ Microbiome DNA Enrichment Kit (New England Biolabs) using 80 µL of the extracted DNA.
